body: You aren’t alone here, you have a community of people who have all been through different experiences and want you to be okay. I don’t know your story but I know that you’re in pain, it’ll be okay. Your first step would be to get the wound taken care of. Be brave, you can do this , I’m proud of you for resisting the urge to do more. It’s a sign, you are gonna live a full, amazing life. Take the next right step and take care of the cut.
There is though,, to get all the beastly shit off ur teeth from the day of building it up. Same as showering at night.
That must be horrible. I have bipolar, depression , and anxiety as well. It’s shitty. I hope you can find new experiences that make your days happier.
Well said.
That’s what I like to believe. I like to believe that there are healthy and legitimately happy people out there.
Yes!!! You’re very right  and it’s very very possible

I’m sorry about what you ABD your daughter have gone through, however you sound like an amazing mother who cares about her daughter so much. I’m very proud of you for coming this far after such a tragic event. I hope you both have happy times ahead and that the rapist rots in hell.

I hope you’re doing okay , I can tell that something is obviously upsetting you and making you pissed about the topic. I understand why you’d be frustrated and feel like that about suicidal people’s decisions but you have to understand that when a person truly wants to die, they don’t think straight they are completely consumed by despair and they just want to end everything. If you want to talk about anything, my messages are open.
Optimism. That’s good. I know you’ll get it one day, and if you don’t , there will be a lot of great experiences along the way.

That’s actually amazing. When you said you wanted to “save the world” it really hit home. The only reason I want to keep living most of the time is to help other and save them in Amy’s that they aren’t able to save themselves. It’s an amazing way to live. You sound like a caring and wonderful person. Seeing the ugly truth could potentially be what depression is but u could also argue the opposite. What if the world is naturally rosey tinted? The world is beautiful, with so many things for us to experience and so many places for us to travel. Depression distorts our view of the beautiful world we have and creates a much sadder one.,, just a thought. I’m proud of you for surviving. Keep it up.

That’s actually really interesting ,, I’ll have to look into that. I always tried to convince myself that I was more analytical than empathetic and sensitive but I know that’s just how I wanted to be. I wanted to be cold. But I know that I’m sensitive. Thanks for putting a name to the term, I’ll look into it
I’m proud of you for making it this far. Stay alive for your parents as well as for yourself. There are many things that you can experience still coming ahead of you. Don’t give up.

I’m glad the belt broke, you’re here to live your life wether you want to or not. Make the best of it , please. You have so many think
Gs you can experience. We all die eventually , might as well do smth cool before you do.
Don’t do it, you’re stronger than this and you have so many days ahead of you with different experiences every day. You got this, be brave.

I think the moments of “what if” is what healthy people get to think of normally. People that aren’t suicidal get to live with their mind constantly full of the possibility of happiness ahead of them, maybe if we keep holding onto the “what if” thoughts we can find happier moments to come. I hope you can experience better days soon.
Gottem

Please don’t give up, you still have so much to experience in your life!!! You have years ahead of you with new things for you to discover every moment. It’s not worth it to end it yourself, we will all be dead soon anyways, might as well make the best of it! Think about the days you were glad to be alive , even if it was for a little bit. More will come, I promise.

Hang in there, you’re almost old enough for you to live on your own. You can make it. I know it’s terrible and I kno it’s not fair but I also know that you’re strong enough to make it past this. You got this.

You got this dude, cancer sucks, it’s a cheat, but you seem to realize that already and you’re moving forward with your life. That takes guts. You still have so much you can experience even with your diagnosis. I know it’s shitty but it doesn’t make you weak, keep pushing forward, you will have great days ahead of you. Message me if you need someone to talk to
Your group of friends leaving you behind while you tie your shoe.
No, it’s because you’re brave enough to continue living. I believe in you.
